Dear Mr. Harrison,

I am pleased to inform you that your application for the Senior Marketing Manager position at GlobalTech Inc. has been approved. After careful review of your qualifications and interview performance, the hiring committee has unanimously decided to offer you the position.

Your starting salary will be $85,000 per year, with a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, dental coverage, and a retirement savings plan. You will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus of up to 15% of your base salary.

Please confirm your acceptance by responding to this email no later than March 15. Your expected start date would be April 1. Prior to your first day, please complete the enclosed onboarding documents and return them to our Human Resources department.

We look forward to welcoming you to the GlobalTech team.

Sincerely,
Sarah Mitchell
Director of Human Resources
GlobalTech Inc.

subQuestions.question: What is the primary purpose of this email?
subQuestions.explanation: 이메일에서 'your application has been approved'와 'offer you the position'이라고 명시하고 있으므로 채용 제안이 목적입니다.

subQuestions.question: What is Mr. Harrison required to do before March 15?
choices: Confirm his acceptance of the offer
subQuestions.explanation: 'confirm your acceptance by responding to this email no later than March 15'라고 되어 있으므로 3월 15일까지 수락 여부를 확인해야 합니다.

subQuestions.question: What is NOT mentioned as part of the benefits package?
subQuestions.explanation: 건강보험, 치과 보장, 퇴직 저축 플랜은 언급되었지만, 스톡옵션(stock options)은 언급되지 않았습니다.

subQuestions.question: What is the maximum total compensation Mr. Harrison could receive in his first year?

MEMORANDUM

To: All Employees
From: Office of the CEO
Date: October 5
Subject: Updated Remote Work Policy

Effective November 1, Nextera Solutions will implement a revised remote work policy. After reviewing employee feedback and productivity data from the past two years, we have decided to adopt a hybrid work model.

Key changes include:

• All full-time employees may work remotely up to three days per week.
• Employees must be present in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays for team collaboration days.
• Remote work arrangements must be approved by the employee's direct supervisor.
• Employees are required to maintain regular working hours (9 AM – 5 PM) regardless of work location.
• A monthly home office stipend of $100 will be provided to eligible employees to cover internet and equipment costs.

Please note that certain positions, particularly those involving client-facing responsibilities or specialized equipment, may have different requirements. Department managers will communicate any position-specific guidelines by October 20.

For questions or concerns regarding the new policy, please contact the HR department at hr@nextera.com.

subQuestions.question: When will the new remote work policy go into effect?
subQuestions.explanation: 'Effective November 1'이라고 명시되어 있습니다. 10월 5일은 메모 작성일, 10월 20일은 부서별 가이드라인 전달 기한입니다.

subQuestions.question: How many days per week are employees required to work in the office?
subQuestions.explanation: 화요일과 목요일이 팀 협업일로 지정되어 있으므로 주 2일 사무실 근무가 필수입니다.

subQuestions.question: What is the purpose of the $100 monthly stipend?
choices: To cover internet and equipment costs for remote work
To pay for professional development courses
To subsidize lunch during office days
subQuestions.explanation: 'to cover internet and equipment costs'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

subQuestions.question: Which employees might NOT follow the standard remote work schedule?
choices: New hires in their first year
subQuestions.explanation: 'positions involving client-facing responsibilities or specialized equipment'이 다른 요건을 가질 수 있다고 언급되어 있습니다.

Global Smartphone Market Sees Unexpected Shift in Q3

By Jennifer Park, Technology Correspondent

The global smartphone market experienced a surprising reversal in the third quarter, with mid-range devices outselling premium models for the first time in five years, according to a report released by market research firm TechAnalytics.

Total smartphone shipments reached 315 million units in Q3, representing a 4% increase from the same period last year. However, the composition of sales shifted dramatically. Mid-range smartphones (priced between $200 and $500) accounted for 52% of total revenue, up from 38% in the previous year. Meanwhile, premium devices (over $500) saw their market share decline from 45% to 35%.

"Consumers are becoming more price-conscious while also recognizing that mid-range phones now offer features that were exclusive to flagship models just two years ago," said David Chen, lead analyst at TechAnalytics.

The trend was most pronounced in Asia-Pacific markets, where mid-range sales grew by 28%. European markets showed a more moderate shift, with mid-range sales increasing by 12%. North American consumers, however, continued to favor premium brands, though the gap narrowed considerably.

Industry experts predict this trend will continue into the next fiscal year, prompting several major manufacturers to invest more heavily in their mid-range product lines.

subQuestions.question: What was the most significant finding in the Q3 report?
choices: Mid-range devices outsold premium models in revenue
A new smartphone manufacturer entered the market
subQuestions.explanation: 'mid-range devices outselling premium models for the first time in five years'가 핵심 발견입니다.

subQuestions.question: According to the article, what percentage of total revenue did premium devices account for in Q3?
subQuestions.explanation: 프리미엄 기기의 시장 점유율이 45%에서 35%로 하락했다고 되어 있습니다.

subQuestions.question: In which region was the shift toward mid-range phones LEAST noticeable?
subQuestions.explanation: 북미 소비자들은 '프리미엄 브랜드를 계속 선호했다(continued to favor premium brands)'고 되어 있어 변화가 가장 적었습니다.

subQuestions.question: What does David Chen suggest is driving the trend?
choices: Mid-range phones now offer features previously found only in flagship models
Premium phones have become less reliable
Consumers are switching to tablets instead
New government regulations favor mid-range pricing
subQuestions.explanation: David Chen은 '중저가폰이 이제 2년 전 플래그십 모델에만 있던 기능을 제공한다'고 분석했습니다.

NOTICE

Annual Building Maintenance Schedule — Riverside Office Complex

Please be advised that the following maintenance work will be conducted during the month of August:

August 5-7 (Mon-Wed): Elevator maintenance and inspection
• Only elevators in Building A will be affected. Building B elevators will operate normally.
• Employees in Building A are advised to use the stairwell or Building B elevators during this period.

August 12-16 (Mon-Fri): HVAC system upgrade
• Air conditioning will be temporarily unavailable on floors 3-5 of Building B.
• Portable cooling units will be provided for affected areas.
• Employees on affected floors may request temporary relocation to available conference rooms on other floors.

August 19-20 (Mon-Tue): Parking lot resurfacing
• The east parking lot will be closed. Employees who normally park there should use the west parking lot or the temporary overflow parking at 250 River Road.
• A free shuttle service will run between the overflow parking lot and the office complex every 15 minutes from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

August 26-30 (Mon-Fri): Fire alarm system testing
• Periodic alarm sounds should be expected throughout the week.
• No evacuation is necessary unless specifically announced by building security.

For questions, contact Building Management at ext. 4500.

subQuestions.question: How long will the HVAC system upgrade take?
What alternative is provided for employees affected by the parking lot closure?
choices: A free shuttle service to overflow parking
Reserved spaces in Building A garage
subQuestions.explanation: 250 River Road의 임시 주차장과 15분 간격 무료 셔틀 서비스가 제공된다고 명시되어 있습니다.

subQuestions.question: During the fire alarm testing, what should employees do when they hear an alarm?
choices: Continue working unless building security announces an evacuation
subQuestions.explanation: 'No evacuation is necessary unless specifically announced by building security'라고 명시되어 있습니다.
